<details><summary>Details</summary>

🟡 **P3** · `test-gap` · `medium confidence`

### questions/downgraded wiring in _run_record untested end-to-end

The _run_record function now computes RunRecord.questions and RunRecord.downgraded from result.findings, but no test flows a ReviewResult that contains questions or evidence-gate-downgraded P1s through build_sticky_comment and then reads the counts back from the parsed state blob. If the wrong source (e.g., the matched records instead of the raw result findings) were passed to count_downgrades, or if the is_question predicate were inverted, all existing tests would still pass.

<details><summary>💡 Why this matters & how to fix</summary>

**Cause:** The test_severity_gate.py suite verifies RunRecord serialisation in isolation (RunRecord.from_dict(record.to_dict())) and count_downgrades in isolation, but no test exercises the _run_record wiring path: ReviewResult.findings → sum(is_question) / count_downgrades → RunRecord constructor → state blob.

**Fix:** Add one test to test_github_sticky_state.py that builds a sample_review_result whose findings include a question and a downgraded P1 (failure_scenario omitted), calls build_sticky_comment, parses the RunRecord from the returned state blob, and asserts RunRecord.questions == 1 and RunRecord.downgraded == 1.

</details>
